findings.summary: No class for ball or cage faults: ball-fault windows are called outer_race with mean calibrated confidence 0.99 and are never withheld by the abstention threshold; cage-fault windows are 54 % withheld, the rest called normal.

Trained and evaluated on simulated data only (speed x severity x noise x plant-drift grid). Held-out simulated conditions reach 1.000 accuracy in steady state, 0.969 at 100 % noise and 0.815 in the start-up transient; no real-machine validation exists.
Distilled from dc_motor/pc/classifier 2026-10-18_run01 (test accuracy 0.916). FP16 TFLite parity on the test runs: accuracy 0.949 -> 0.949, top-1 agreement 0.999 (host CPU, not target hardware).
